mapper.sql: SELECT grade_name, on_img_url, off_img_url, sold_img_url, surcharge FROM seat_grade
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seat_grade (grade_name, on_img_url, off_img_url, sold_img_url, surcharge) VALUES (#{grade_name}, #{on_img_url}, #{off_img_url}, #{sold_img_url}, #{surcharge})
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_grade SET grade_name = #{grade_name}, on_img_url = #{on_img_url}, off_img_url = #{off_img_url}, sold_img_url = #{sold_img_url}, surcharge = #{surcharge} WHERE seat_grade_id = #{seat_grade_id}
